title: Who Discovered Madeira, and Where Did They Land?
description: Zarco and Tristão Vaz Teixeira, squires of Prince Henry, reached Porto Santo in 1418 and Madeira in 1419. Tradition puts the landing at Machico on 1 July.
heroAlt: Machico bay on Madeira's east coast seen from the sea in early morning light
keywords: where did Zarco land in Madeira

images.prompt: Realistic photograph of Machico bay on Madeira's east coast, taken from the sea about a kilometre offshore at sunrise. The wide bay with its town at the back, green valley climbing behind, steep headlands on both sides, a calm grey blue sea with soft swell in the foreground. Warm low light on the slopes, no boat in the frame, no people, no text.
images.alt: Machico bay on Madeira's east coast seen from the sea in early morning light
